admin.title: Staff & Badges
admin.name_hint: As it should appear on their badge
admin.email_hint: This is the username they sign in with.
admin.can_sign_in: They can sign in as soon as this is saved.
admin.escalation_note: Receives gate approvals escalated at 15 minutes
admin.shown_once_body: There is no way to look it up again. If this card is not printed, the badge has to be reissued — which is safe, just wasted time.
admin.password_body: Hand this password over in person. It is not stored anywhere and cannot be shown again — if it is lost, reset it from Supabase Auth.
admin.self_body: You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself. Another Admin can, once one is in place.
admin.retention_off_body: Storage is not configured on the server, so nothing is being destroyed. Photos are accumulating past the {{days}}-day limit.
admin.overdue_body: The worker clears these within a few hours. If this number is not falling, the worker has stopped — nothing else will report that.
admin.badge_replaced_body: Any badge {{name}} was already carrying stopped working the moment this one was created.
